cand.title: Rive Jazzy 2027
cand.excerpt: Verified organized demand is valuable, but committed venue and absent lodging data reduce current accessibility.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Thomas Greter — Direction Opérationnelle: strongest first approach for operational accommodation needs and routing to whoever books; purchasing/signature authority is unverified. Thomas Winteler — Direction Artistique: relevant for visiting performers and artist travel requirements; accommodation contract control is unverified. Both are named on the official committee page and 2026 press dossier.
findings.futureEdition: Official organizer announcement: “See you in Summer 2027 (01.07-08.08)”. The festival network identifies the 34th edition as 1 July–8 August 2027 in Quartier de Rive, Nyon. These are activity-window dates, not article dates, and fall within the requested horizon. The detailed 2027 concert calendar and any dark dates are not established. No 2028 edition announcement was found. A third-party page saying 2027 dates are unknown is superseded by the organizer and official tourism listings.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: YOTEL Geneva Lake is territorially relevant in Founex/La Côte, but off-site from the walkable Nyon waterfront festival. Best conditional use is short-stay visiting artists, technical crew or small operational groups with agreed late-evening transport. The historical press dossier describes most bands as 3–9 musicians, with occasional big bands; this does not establish room requirements. Published audience totals are spread across the festival and cannot justify a 20–120-room peak block, let alone all 237 rooms. No evidence supports meeting-room, retreat or resort buyout demand; the six meeting rooms are not a demonstrated event need.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2027 venue: Quartier de Rive, lakeside Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland — within the Nyon/La Côte primary territory, not Geneva city or Lausanne. This is a multi-site district festival, not a hotel meeting. The tourism listing gives Rue de Rive 54 as the festival location/contact address; this is not proof that all performances occur at that address. Exact 2027 stage allocations and signed site commitments are not published in the reviewed evidence. Historical sites include Place de Savoie, Place du Molard, Fontaine Maître-Jaques, Plage des Trois-Jetées, O’ Les Terrasses du Lac and Les Marronniers.
findings.historicalRotation: No destination-bidding rotation evidenced: 2024, 2025 and 2026 summer editions all used Quartier de Rive, Nyon. Published windows: 4 July–11 August 2024; 3 July–10 August 2025; 2 July–9 August 2026. Movement between neighborhood stages is intra-festival circulation, not destination rotation. The organizer also describes an annual Rosey Concert Hall partnership; that separate concert is not evidence that the summer festival relocates.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Official lodging page states: “Découvrez nos hôtels partenaires pour votre séjour au festival.” Every hotel on that page: Le Rive, Rue de Rive 15, Nyon; Maison du Lac, Place de Savoie 1, Nyon. These are undated accommodation recommendations, not verified 2027 artist contracts, allocations, exclusive host hotels or room blocks. No edition-specific rates, room quantities, room nights, housing mandate or open RFP were found. Separately, Festivals Nyon says “Les réservations de logements via la plateforme sont actuellement closes” and directs visitors to Nyon tourism for accommodation information. This is a general regional visitor pathway, not proof of an appointed Rive Jazzy housing bureau. Actual artist/crew booking responsibility remains unknown.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-linked cultural festival run by a named volunteer organizing committee. The 2026 programme places it within the activities of the Association pour l’Animation du Quartier de Rive; the press dossier says organizers invest their time voluntarily and identifies municipal, merchant and restaurant support. Rive Jazzy is the programme/organizing team, not the municipality or a hotel. No external PCO/DMC or corporate event agency is identified. The legal entity that signs lodging contracts is not established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Le Rive and Maison du Lac already receive official accommodation visibility in Nyon and emphasize proximity to performances. Their promotional presence is a competitive advantage, not evidence of committed 2027 inventory or exclusivity. No sourced sellout, capacity shortfall, displaced block, overflow request or guaranteed transport to Founex was found. Attendance is not lodging demand: the 2026 press dossier claims more than 15,000 spectators annually, while July 2026 local reporting says nearly 10,000; neither is a confirmed 2027 attendance or peak-room figure.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Thomas Greter first through the official general contact route or published operational number, copying/routing to Thomas Winteler for artist needs. Ask who contracts and pays for accommodation, whether Le Rive/Maison du Lac agreements cover artists or only visitor referrals, which 2027 performance nights require overnight stays, party sizes, single/twin mix, budgets, booking deadlines and late-return transfers. Offer a conditional small artist/crew allocation only after those answers; do not hold the full festival window or assume a 20-room minimum. If no overnight need or partner access exists, retain a light-touch future relationship rather than forecast group revenue.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 edition is confirmed, but accommodation procurement is unconfirmed. No public open sourcing path is established. Festival venue identity is published; stage contracts and lodging contracts are separate and remain unverified. General regional platform reservations are currently closed, which must not be interpreted as all hotel supply sold or the organizer’s procurement closed. Direct organizer qualification is appropriate; do not present this as a live block RFP.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue a supplementary accommodation relationship for visiting musicians/crew, subject to actual overnight needs, incumbent terms, budget and transfers. Seek inclusion as an additional lodging option only if the organizer welcomes it; do not assume partner displacement. Later-cycle capture is a relationship strategy grounded in verified recurrence, not a confirmed 2028 event or venue opportunity. Moving this neighborhood festival into the hotel is not supported.
